scientific_integrity: The full proof is mathematical rather than computational. A self-contained Python 3 checker independently evaluates exact conditional moments, exercises inversion, and supplements the envelope with finite randomized checks. No external independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Requires independently arclength-uniform boundary endpoints and known perimeter; exact population moments. Conditioning worsens as area tends to zero. The published second-moment identity is prior work. The 1982 Gates full text could not be inspected and historical priority remains provisional.
title: Sharp fourth-distance-moment tomography for triangular perimeters
